messages:
nina: quick poll: for the Create Credential form — should validation be inline-on-blur or only show after submit? also thinking about hint density.

rafe: inline on blur for simple checks (format, length). submit-level for server-side checks (uniqueness). keep inline hints very short (1 line) and move examples to a collapsible 'Examples' section.

sophie: accessibility: if showing a summary after submit, focus it and use role=\"alert\". each summary item should link to the field and set focus there when clicked.

tim: required field approach: I prefer marking optional fields with '(optional)'. less visual noise for most forms where most are required. either way, include a short legend like 'Fields marked * are required' if using asterisks.

a11y-bot: Reminder: avoid color-only cues. use aria-required, aria-invalid, and aria-describedby for errors. ensure contrast and visible focus on custom controls.

nina: what about destructive confirmations? current modal is too vague. proposal: explicit consequence + typed-confirm for high-risk actions. example copy below.

rafe: yep. sample:
```
Title: Delete API key "cli-token-42"?
Body: This will immediately revoke the key. Any services using it will fail. Type the key name to confirm.
Confirm: Delete "cli-token-42" (danger)
Cancel: Keep key
```

sophie: microcopy: be consistent with verbs across the console ('Delete' vs 'Revoke' vs 'Remove'). pick one per resource type.

tim: CTA order: keep cancel on the left, primary/destructive on the right (red). ensure Esc closes modal and focus returns to the invoking control.

a11y-bot: Checklist saved: [focus summary, role=alert, aria-invalid on errored fields, aria-required on required fields, link summary items to inputs, typed-confirm for high-impact deletes].

nina: great, I'll update the mock with both required-label variants and the typed-confirm modal. will share Figma link when ready.
